title: smime-tree: no test for intermediate CA chain or pathLen constraint enforcement
description: All current verify() tests use a single-hop chain (leaf directly signed by trust anchor). validate_chain() in cert.rs has logic for intermediate CAs, cycle detection, and pathLen constraints — none of which is exercised by any test. Scenario: a refactor breaks the intermediate CA walk loop and the bug is invisible. Minimum: one test with a 3-cert chain (leaf → intermediate → root); one test confirming pathLen=0 root rejects an intermediate; one test confirming cycle detection fires.
